title: While the setting is off, a change of customer makes the work order billable
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, flagged as an Internal customer, flagged while the setting was on.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A, category Goodwill, in status Approved, made while the setting was on.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click "Change Customer" on the customer card.
  3. Pick customer B.
  4. Confirm the change.
  5. Open work order 2.
  6. Click "Change Customer" on the customer card.
  7. Pick customer C.
  8. Confirm the change.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The window opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer B is picked.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1 stays billable with no "Internal" badge.

Step 5:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 6:

  • The window opens.

Step 7:

  • Customer C is picked.

Step 8:

  • Work order 2 keeps the "No Charge" badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-N1: “If the setting is off, the New Work Order dialog shows no badge, hint or No Charge checkbox, and new work orders for flagged customers are billable. Open internal and no-charge work orders keep their classification, badge, orange header and category; they close as in Story 3 (S1-R10). Billable work orders offer no Convert to No Charge. While the setting is off, an open no-charge work order can still be converted to billable, and its category changed, from the menu; the Convert to Billable confirmation drops its second sentence. A customer change while the setting is off makes the work order billable whatever the new customer's flag; a No Charge mark survives a change to another regular customer.”
